candidate_attribution.conditional_resolution: Report final official tool and exact accuracy conditional on operative inclusion, alongside unconditional full4000 metrics; changed candidate sets make conditional comparisons descriptive.
candidate_attribution.delivery: Bind to the exact delivered Solver source; report legal answers outside candidates, finite exhaustion, abstention, fallback and unresolved issues.
candidate_attribution.ordered_action_coverage: Report primary target in the first action and only in a later action separately. For full expected action sequences, preserve repeated occurrences and action order; distinguish ordered occurrence alignment from any-action set membership. Labels join only in sealed analysis.
candidate_attribution.primary_target_coverage: Report the official primary target in the union across all action candidates separately for initial and operative Perception. Missing or invalid operative source remains unavailable and in the full4000 denominator; never borrow a later attempted state.
candidate_attribution.read_after: Both new full4000 finalized manifests and first official scores, with registered source reads.
candidate_attribution.refresh: Report added/removed candidates, operative versus attempted refresh, changed grouping/order, save/harm and tool use. Observational partitions do not establish causal tool or refresh efficacy.
candidate_attribution.width: Report actual width 1/2/3/4 and empty actions; do not treat width as confidence. Candidate coverage95% remains a development priority, not an exclusive adoption gate.
